title: Resetting a configuration at the initial seam
statement: Let $x$ be an input string, let $l,l'$ be states, let $v$ assign a natural number to each of the $m$ registers, let $out$ be a Boolean output word, and let $r$ be a register. Applying the configuration update that sets the state to $(l',\mathrm{start})$, places the input head at position $1$, and moves register $r$'s work-tape head to $0$ to the initial seam configuration with state $l$ yields the initial seam configuration with state $l'$, with all other contents and positions as specified by that seam configuration.
